name: GZMK40
original_measurement: Pretreatment HNSCC CD8 T-cell discovery; bulk tumour and T-cell pseudobulk evaluation
original_algorithm: R GSVA ssGSEA; 40 upregulated genes from GZMK-positive exhausted CD8 states
derivation: Not derived from another set in this catalog
comparison_limit: Algorithm class matched; normalization and assay-specific equivalence not asserted

name: CYT2
original_measurement: Bulk tumour RNA-seq across TCGA cancers
original_algorithm: Geometric mean / log-average of GZMA and PRF1 TPM
derivation: Two genes also occur in other sets
comparison_limit: Uniform ssGSEA is not the original CYT calculation

name: EXH5
source: Operational comparator in Sievers et al 2026; cites Wherry et al 2007
original_measurement: Five inhibitory-receptor transcripts; original exhaustion biology not a validated five-gene HNSCC predictor
original_algorithm: Five-gene comparator evaluated in the Sievers scoring framework
derivation: PDCD1 CTLA4 LAG3 HAVCR2 TIGIT; overlapping receptors
comparison_limit: Existing manuscript Wang 2024 citation is not the direct provenance of this exact panel

name: IFNG6
original_measurement: Pretreatment FFPE tumour NanoString; melanoma discovery and HNSCC/gastric evaluation
original_algorithm: Mean log10 expression after quantile normalization for six IFN-gamma genes
derivation: Shares genes with GEP18; not a subset of GEP18
comparison_limit: ssGSEA is a gene-set comparison, not reproduction of the assay score

name: TLS9
source: Nine TLS-related markers as listed by Sievers 2026; related marker panel in van Dijk 2020
original_measurement: Tumour expression marker panel associated with TLS; tissue architecture requires separate assessment
original_algorithm: NABUCCO extended data uses average expression of nine TLS-related genes; Sievers uses gene-set scoring
derivation: Not the same membership as the separately derived melanoma TLS nine-gene set
comparison_limit: Do not treat TLS9 as a validated TLS architecture classifier; direct Cabrita derivation of this exact panel remains a provenance distinction

name: GEP18
original_measurement: Pretreatment FFPE tumour NanoString across advanced cancers
original_algorithm: Elastic-net-selected 18 genes; weighted sum of housekeeping-normalized values
derivation: Distinct from the paper's other expanded 18-gene immune panel
comparison_limit: No original coefficients or housekeeping assay normalization reconstructed

name: Korea30
original_measurement: Pretreatment tumour-reactive CXCL13-positive CD8 exhausted T cells
original_algorithm: Top 30 genes ranked by network centrality among responder-enriched network genes; paper reports GSVA signature evaluation
derivation: Derived from responder network, not independent of its discovery outcome
comparison_limit: Exact original numerical scoring settings not reconstructed; deposited CSTW retained without assumed CTSW substitution

name: Dysf238
original_measurement: Intratumoral dysfunctional CD8 T cells in IMCISION before/after dual ICB
original_algorithm: Monocle3 trajectory positively associated genes; AUCell single-cell enrichment unless otherwise stated
comparison_limit: Trajectory state signature, not an original weighted clinical predictor

name: Shared84
original_measurement: Treg and dysfunctional CD8 T-cell trajectories in IMCISION
original_algorithm: Intersection of Dysf238 and Treg372; AUCell enrichment framework
derivation: 84-gene intersection, not independently selected ninth signature
comparison_limit: Exclude from main independence-sensitive comparisons; retain diagnostic sensitivity
